summary.text: Avelino Valencia was first elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 and reelected in November 2024 to represent the 68th Assembly District, which includes Anaheim, Santa Ana and Orange. He chairs the Assembly Banking and Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: From 2020 to 2022 he served on the Anaheim City Council. Earlier, he coached at Fullerton College and worked as a special education instructional assistant in the Anaheim Elementary School District.
He grew up in Orange County and earned an associate degree from Fullerton College, a bachelor's degree from San Jose State University and a master's degree from Johns Hopkins University.
